summary: Frontend-only verification of MOD portal recent changes: equipment cover pills, equipment detail card labels (Service Provider vs Supplier purchased-from), Suppliers/Service-Providers tab filtering, and CRM MOD Service Quote wizard per-line Type badges. Also verified 'Replace existing kit' testid presence in AIKitImportModal.js via code inspection. Nearly all requirements PASS.

Review spec says Type C should show POA with no fixed price. TL is correctly blank; only the £ column contradicts.

Two entries appear: 'Pulse Fitness Ltd' (Grade B) and 'Pulse Fitness' (Grade C). Both are service suppliers (no manufacturer names), but the two very similar names may indicate a dedup / name-normalisation gap. Worth confirming these are truly two distinct orgs.
